title: MonitorBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.28590v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate chains of thought (CoTs) that are not always causally responsible for their final outputs. When such a mismatch occurs, the CoT no longer faithfully reflects the actual reasons (i.e., decision-critical factors) driving the model's behavior, leading to the reduced CoT monitorability problem. This limits the use of CoTs for reliable oversight. However, a comprehensive and fully open-source benchmark for thoroughly evaluating CoT monitorability remains lacking. To address this gap, we propose MonitorBench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating CoT monitorability in LLMs. MonitorBench provides: (1) a diverse set of 1,540 test instances with carefully designed decision-critical factors across 19 tasks spanning 7 categories to characterize when CoTs can be used to monitor the factors driving LLM behavior; and (2) two prompting stress-test settings to quantify the extent to which CoT monitorability

translated_title: MonitorBench：大语言模型思维链可监控性的综合基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）生成的思维链（CoTs）并不总是与其最终输出存在因果关联。当出现这种不匹配时，思维链便无法忠实反映驱动模型行为的实际原因（即决策关键因素），从而导致思维链可监控性下降的问题。这限制了思维链在可靠监督中的应用。然而，目前仍缺乏一个全面且完全开源的基准来深入评估思维链可监控性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MonitorBench，一个用于评估大语言模型思维链可监控性的系统性基准。MonitorBench提供：（1）一个包含1,540个测试实例的多样化数据集，涵盖7个类别共19个任务，并精心设计了决策关键因素，以刻画何时可以借助思维链来监控驱动大语言模型行为的因素；（2）两种提示压力测试设置，用于量化思维链可监控性的程度。
tldr: 该论文提出了MonitorBench，首个全面评估大语言模型思维链可监控性的系统性开源基准，包含涵盖7个类别19个任务的1,540个测试实例以及用于量化可监控性的提示压力测试设置。
en_tdlr: MonitorBench is a comprehensive, fully open-source benchmark for evaluating chain-of-thought monitorability in LLMs, featuring 1,540 test instances across 19 tasks in 7 categories along with prompting stress-test settings to quantify monitorability.
